changes.summary: <lens-formula> and solid.FormulaProps take a note: a templ page shows the figure's explanation inside the ƒ instead of a separate ⓘ.

Lens formula: the pinned variable list states compact figures in full so the operands add up; a field ref may name an availability column, and a variable without a value says why (configuration required, no source data); the hover preview tells the reader a click lists the variables, and a variable's hover shows its source.
Lens formula variables carry their own format for Ref-resolved values; a panel with a formula shows its note inside the ƒ instead of a separate ⓘ.
